As Ebay (EBAY) Stock Declined, Pictet & Cie Europe Sa Has Lifted Its Stake; As Apple (AAPL) Shares Rose, Holder Partnervest Advisory Services Decreased Its Stake
June 17, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Partnervest Advisory Services Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 15.45% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Partnervest Advisory Services Llc sold 3,628 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 19,855 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.33 million, down from 23,483 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Partnervest Advisory Services Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $928.18 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $188.84. About 33.10M shares traded or 10.09% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
